tests.name: package_build
tests.details: patrol built successfully with colcon build --symlink-install.

tests.name: pure_command_selection
tests.details: Both no-pose and ordinary-pose cases passed under pytest and colcon test.

tests.name: pose_subscription
tests.details: /turtle1/pose had the turtlesim publisher and patrol subscriber, and patrol published a nonzero command after receiving a pose.

tests.name: relative_topic_defect
tests.details: /cmd_vel had one publisher and zero subscriptions while /turtle1/cmd_vel had no publisher; repeated pose readings remained unchanged.

tests.name: remap_and_rate
tests.details: Remapping cmd_vel connected patrol to turtlesim, changed the pose, and produced a measured final average of 9.999 Hz over 97 intervals.

tests.name: shutdown_timeout
tests.details: Two seconds after patrol stopped, turtlesim reported zero linear and angular velocity.
